Offline build tools and runtime compatibility. Babel standalone 7.26.10 (MIT), core-js-bundle 3.41.0 (MIT), Acorn 8.14.1 (MIT). json2 0.4.0 is public domain; its notice is preserved in the source. Files are copied from the npm tarballs, with unused Babel/core-js source-map references removed and trailing whitespace normalized; Acorn is used only for build/tests. Babel is used only at build time and is not included in the XP app. core-js and json2 are embedded runtime support.
